description: This file defines the Authorization class, which models the <authorization> XML element in the OFBiz service configuration. It includes a constructor that extracts the service-name attribute and a getter method.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Immutable class representing an <authorization> element with a service name attribute.

methods.name: Authorization
methods.description: Constructor that initializes Authorization from an XML Element, extracting the service-name attribute.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name associated with this authorization.
